title: CUBE CRAZE (RUBIKS CUBE)
rules:
Game Setup

  • Participants will compete in teams of two.
  • Every team will receive one Rubik's Cube with the same predetermined scramble.
  • One teammate will be the Director, and the other will be the Solver.
  • The Solver must wear a blindfold throughout Rounds 1 and 2.
  • If the Solver removes the blindfold at any time during these rounds, the team will be disqualified.
  • Team members cannot switch roles during the competition. The Director must remain the Director, and the Solver must remain the Solver.
  • Once the cube is solved, the Solver must place the cube on the table to stop the timer.
  • The competition consists of three rounds.

General Rules

  • The decisions of the organizers will be final and binding.
  • Unsportsmanlike behavior, cheating, or any violation of the rules may result in disqualification.
  • Participants are expected to follow all instructions given by the event coordinators throughout the competition.

additionalSections.title: Round 1 – Verbal Guidance Round
additionalSections.content:
How to Play

  • The Director may look at the cube.
  • The Director must verbally guide the blindfolded Solver to solve the cube.
  • The Director must not touch the cube at any time.
  • The Solver may act only on the Director's verbal instructions.
  • Each team will have 15 minutes to solve the cube.
  • Teams that do not solve the cube within the time limit will be eliminated.
  • The top 5 teams with the shortest solving times will advance to Round 2.

additionalSections.title: Round 2 – Opposite Direction Round
additionalSections.content:
How to Play

  • The Director may look at the cube.
  • The Director must guide the blindfolded Solver using opposite or misleading verbal instructions (reverse psychology).
  • The Solver must continue to follow the Director's instructions.
  • The Director must not touch the cube.
  • Each team will have 20 minutes to solve the cube.
  • The top 3 teams with the shortest solving times will qualify for the Final Round.

additionalSections.title: Round 3 – Final Round – Pyraminx Showdown
additionalSections.content:
• Each qualifying team will receive a Pyraminx.
  • No blindfold will be used in this round.
  • Only one member from each team may participate.
  • The participating member must be chosen by the team before the round begins.
  • Each participant will have 10 minutes to solve the Pyraminx.
  • The team whose participating member solves the Pyraminx in the shortest time will be declared the winner of Cube Craze.
